findings.title: Missing DPA and sub-DPA for Indian affiliate processing data
findings.deviation: The agreement contains local data protection compliance obligations and restricts data transfer without approval, but does not incorporate a Standard Data Protection Addendum (DPA) or explicitly authorize data processing and offshore access by AtliQ's Indian affiliate (AtliQ Technologies Pvt Ltd) which actually performs the services and issues invoices.
findings.impact: AtliQ's Indian development team may technically violate data transfer restrictions or local data regulations by accessing the customer's cloud environment or data from offshore without an executed DPA.
findings.quote: 14.1 AtliQ shall process personal data only on TravelHub's documented instructions and in compliance with Federal Decree-Law No. 45 of 2021 on the Protection of Personal Data and, where applicable, the Saudi Personal Data Protection Law. 14.2 AtliQ shall not transfer Customer Data outside the TravelHub cloud environment without prior written approval.
findings.counterPosition: Add a standard Data Protection Addendum (DPA) as an annex and include language explicitly authorizing offshore data processing/access by AtliQ's Indian affiliate, AtliQ Technologies Pvt Ltd.

fine.note: No liquidated damages or delay penalties are specified in the agreement, which is highly favorable for AtliQ.
Payment terms are 30 days from invoice date (meeting the 45-day maximum) with no set-off or pay-when-paid clauses.
Liability is mutually capped at 1x the fees paid in the preceding 12 months, with standard carve-outs for confidentiality and wilful misconduct.
AtliQ's indemnity is limited to standard third-party IP infringement, and all indemnities are safely capped under the general liability limit.
IP ownership in custom deliverables vests in the customer only upon full payment, and AtliQ retains ownership of its background technology with a non-exclusive license.
Termination for convenience requires a reasonable 30 days' notice, and AtliQ is entitled to payment for all work performed up to the termination date.
Confidentiality obligations are mutual and survive for a standard and reasonable period of 3 years post-termination.
The non-solicitation clause is mutual, restricted only to personnel directly involved in the services, and limited to 12 months.
No insurance requirements, minimum coverage limits, or certificate provisions are imposed on AtliQ.
The contract includes a supplier-friendly 10-business-day review period with a clear deemed acceptance mechanism.
The warranty period is limited to a reasonable 60 days post-acceptance and restricted to material conformity with agreed specs.
The agreement contains no set-off clauses, preventing the customer from unilaterally withholding payments.
